clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For the last 3 Financial Years) 3 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: The bidder must have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs 3 lakh over the last 3 financial years.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.summary: The OEM of the offered product must have an average turnover of Rs 26 lakh over the last 3 years.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: Years of Past Experience Required for same/similar service 3 Year (s)
clauses.summary: The bidder needs 3 years of past experience in the same or similar supply.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No
clauses.summary: No MSE relaxation is given for the turnover requirement.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No
clauses.summary: No MSE relaxation is given for the experience requirement.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: Startup Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No
clauses.summary: No startup relaxation is given for the turnover requirement.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: Startup Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No
clauses.summary: No startup relaxation is given for the experience requirement.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: Experience Criteria,Past Performance,Bidder Turnover,Certificate (Requested in ATC),OEM Authorization Certificate,OEM Annual Turnover,Additional Doc 1 (Requested in ATC)
clauses.summary: Sellers must upload experience, past performance, bidder turnover, OEM authorisation and OEM turnover documents.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: In case any bidder is seeking exemption from Experience / Turnover Criteria, the supporting documents to prove his eligibility for exemption must be uploaded for evaluation by the buyer
clauses.summary: Bidders seeking exemption from experience or turnover criteria must upload supporting documents proving eligibility.

clauses.heading: EMD Detail
clauses.quote: Mediation Clause No Bid Details /EMD Detail O /Required No
clauses.summary: No EMD is required for this bid.

clauses.quote: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three financial years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document.
clauses.summary: Bidder's average turnover over the last three financial years must meet the stated minimum, validated from GeM data.

clauses.heading: 2. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: the Bidder or its OEM of the product offered in the bid {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for number of Financial years as indicated above in the bid document before the bid opening date.
clauses.summary: Bidder or its OEM must have supplied similar products to government bodies/PSUs for the stated number of financial years.

clauses.heading: 2. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts and delivery acceptance certificates like CRAC to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contracts and delivery acceptance certificates must be submitted to prove supply in each financial year.

clauses.heading: 3. OEM Turn Over Criteria
clauses.quote: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document.
clauses.summary: The OEM's average annual turnover over the last three years must meet the stated minimum.

clauses.heading: 3. OEM Turn Over Criteria
clauses.quote: Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid.
clauses.summary: Audited balance sheets or a CA/Cost Accountant certificate of OEM turnover must be uploaded.

clauses.heading: 4. Past Performance
clauses.quote: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through re-seller(s)} should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 10% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three Financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU.
clauses.summary: Bidder or OEM must have supplied 10% of bid quantity of similar products to government/PSU in one of the last three financial years.

clauses.heading: 4. Past Performance
clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts (proving supply of cumulative order quantity in any one financial year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contract copies proving the cumulative supplied quantity in one financial year must be submitted.

clauses.heading: 8 OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS
clauses.quote: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted.
clauses.summary: For imported products, the OEM or its authorised seller must have a registered Indian office for after-sales support, with a certificate submitted.
